name: Juneau
seo_title: Juneau Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Juneau, Alaska for 2026: 4 family events, including The Nutcracker and Gallery Walk, with dates checked on each host's site.
lede: Juneau's season begins with the first-Friday Gallery Walk and a Nutcracker weekend, then a symphony holiday concert and a library gingerbread workshop.
celebrates: Juneau's holiday season opens on December 4, when the Juneau Arts and Humanities Council's Gallery Walk fills downtown from Glacier Avenue to South Franklin Street with more than 50 stops, carolers, live music, Santa and hot chocolate. The same weekend Juneau Dance Theatre stages The Nutcracker from December 4 to 6. The Juneau Symphony follows with Holiday Cheer on December 12 and 13, featuring the Sitka Holiday Brass and the Vox Borealis choir, and Juneau Public Libraries hold a Gingerbread House Workshop at the Mendenhall Valley library on December 19.
lastyear: The Gallery Walk is an annual first Friday of December event in downtown Juneau, according to a local business listing, and the Juneau Arts and Humanities Council described its December walk as a night when 50 or more downtown galleries and shops open with art, live music and carolers. We did not find a 2025 host page with dates for the other Juneau events, so we list only the 2026 dates that hosts have posted. The Gallery Walk returns on Friday, December 4.
facts: Juneau is Alaska's capital and cannot be reached by road, so families get to its holiday events on foot, by car within the city or by ferry and plane from elsewhere. The Gallery Walk stretches from Glacier Avenue to South Franklin Street, according to the Juneau Arts and Humanities Council. The Juneau Symphony's Holiday Cheer concerts are held at two schools, Juneau-Douglas High School on Saturday and Thunder Mountain Middle School on Sunday.
trains: Juneau has no rail line, and we did not find a train ride in the city. The nearest Alaska Railroad history is far away in Anchorage and Seward. See our Anchorage and Seward pages if you are traveling elsewhere in Alaska this December.
traditions: A first-Friday holiday arts night with more than 50 downtown stops, carolers, music, Santa and hot chocolate.
Juneau Dance Theatre stages the holiday ballet at Juneau-Douglas High School.
The Juneau Symphony plays carols with brass and choir guests.
Juneau Public Libraries host a building afternoon at Valley Library.

faq: Juneau holds a downtown Gallery Walk on the first Friday of December, with carolers, live music, Santa and hot chocolate, and Juneau Dance Theatre stages The Nutcracker that weekend. The Juneau Symphony plays a Holiday Cheer concert on December 12 and 13.
Is there a free Christmas event in Juneau?
None of the hosts on this page print a price or call their event free, so we list each as price not listed. Gallery Walk stops set their own offerings.
Where can kids meet Santa in Juneau?
The Juneau Arts and Humanities Council lists Santa among the stops at the December 4 Gallery Walk.
Is there a train ride in Juneau?
No. Juneau has no rail line, and we did not find a train ride in the city.
What is the best Juneau event for toddlers?
The 2 pm Nutcracker matinees on December 5 and 6, the Sunday 3 pm symphony concert and the gingerbread workshop on December 19 all suit younger children.
